scope: Faithful source-view and standardized PHG rendering expansion; exact copies remain explicit and new generations remain unvalidated candidates.

secondaryPortCapture.A: Copy existing RGB reference screenshot byte-exactly, keeping black background and external dreadlocks; preserve original DDS separately. Never claim franchise original, native DDS pixels or alpha sprite.
secondaryPortCapture.B: New ImageGen mask-only transparent asset faithful to visible near-front source design; remove external wearer/dreads, preserve grayscale because original albedo and per-mask game origin are unknown.

officialPhoto.R: Preserve actual downloaded publisher photographs byte-exactly with URL, page, SHA, dimensions and edition.
officialPhoto.A: New transparent ImageGen source-view extraction, faithful to sculpture, visible palette and camera. Not a pixel-identical source-photo copy or a certified original film/game model.
officialPhoto.B: New distinct ImageGen rendering using A plus photographs, preserving shape, camera and known palette; standardized material/light presentation only.
editionScopeExamples: NECA Fire and Stone Ahab SDCC2014 edition, distinct from Ultimate2017 and other comic iterations.
NECA GoldenAngel2018 has two distinct photographed mask accessories; both remain edition-specific.
NECA Viper is an original NECA design explicitly described as such, not a Kenner homage.

prototype.qualification: Always display prototype/not-final limitation; no claim of exact film release geometry.
prototype.kweiEdition: NECA Ultimate Kwei Predator prototype shown on official store, not final product.

phgPresentation.light: Restrained upper-left key and soft frontal fill
phgPresentation.materials: Physically plausible metal/paint, source-specific wear, readable medium-scale relief and controlled grain
phgPresentation.palette: Preserve documented colors; remain neutral grayscale when original albedo is unknown
phgPresentation.camera: Preserve source-view; do not invent a new frontal view or hidden rear geometry
phgPresentation.isolation: One rigid mask only; omit wearer, flesh, teeth, clothing and external dreadlocks
phgPresentation.alpha: True transparent exterior; no painted matte/checkerboard, no ground shadow plane
phgPresentation.framing: All visible silhouette inside canvas, requested8–12 percent transparent margins; smaller native margins documented if unclipped

guardrails: No new horns, vents, runes, teeth, engravings or guessed hidden geometry.
Use ImageGen for every asset creation/correction; no CPU cropping, resizing, recoloring, reencoding or alpha editing.
Read-only raster measurement and browser/CSS display comparisons do not alter assets.
Archive all attempts and retain their native bytes; copy accepted output byte-identically.
Two rendering candidates do not certify1:1 franchise fidelity, human validation, runtime integration or automatic Bible/Excel closure.
City Hunter of97 and Kawaii Phoenix are explicitly variants, not two newly established independent geometries.
Secondary port localization proves community naming only; README credits multiple games without per-mask proof.
